{{Top}}
A '''locator''' or '''signal locator''' was a personal device that worked similar to a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] and sent a signal allowing its location to be tracked. For example, when [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Treetower]] encountered trouble in the skies over [[Yorn Skot]], [[High Orbit Precision Entry Squad]] used his locator to find the unconscious Jedi.

The [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Imperial Sector Police]] often had [[locator ring]]s, rings with a locator device that could be worn on a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid's]] finger, to keep track of suspects.<ref name="CN II">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>
